import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_12/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_12/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Operation History: JOIN on ["Athlete"]
# Join df0 and df1 on the 'Athlete' column (inner join to keep only matching athletes)
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="Athlete", how="inner")

# Ensure the target schema and types:
# Target Schema: 
# ['Athlete': string, 'Age': float, 'Year': integer, 'Closing Ceremony Date': string, 
#  'Gold Medals': integer, 'Silver Medals': integer, 'Bronze Medals': integer, 
#  'Total Medals': integer, 'Country': string]

# Convert columns to the correct types:
df_joined["Athlete"] = df_joined["Athlete"].astype(str)
df_joined["Age"] = df_joined["Age"].astype(float)
df_joined["Year"] = df_joined["Year"].astype(int)
df_joined["Closing Ceremony Date"] = df_joined["Closing Ceremony Date"].astype(str)

# Medal columns to integer
medal_columns = ["Gold Medals", "Silver Medals", "Bronze Medals", "Total Medals"]
for col in medal_columns:
    df_joined[col] = df_joined[col].astype(int)

df_joined["Country"] = df_joined["Country"].astype(str)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    "Athlete",
    "Age",
    "Year",
    "Closing Ceremony Date",
    "Gold Medals",
    "Silver Medals",
    "Bronze Medals",
    "Total Medals",
    "Country"
]

df_target = df_joined[target_columns]

# Write the result to the specified path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_12/target_multisource.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
